en: Vintage multi-view postcard printed in monochrome tones with red captions. The upper image shows a broad panorama of a town along a winding river with hills on both sides and a suspension bridge crossing the river. The lower left image depicts a steep rocky hill or cliff (Schäferwand) rising above houses and a riverside road. The lower right image shows another stretch of the same river with boats, bridges, riverside buildings, and hills. The captions in German identify the scenes as views of Tetschen-Bodenbach on the River Elbe.
